description: Design, calibrate and analyze evidence-based model/human graders or paired output comparisons.

routing.when_to_use: Design, calibrate and analyze evidence-based model/human graders or paired output comparisons.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: one-property rubric dimensions and anchored scales; authorized held-out human-labeled examples and disagreement evidence; direct/pairwise objective and observed judgments; candidate IDs and swapped-position mapping; budget and execution authority

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: anchored evidence-first grader specification; held-out calibration and disagreement analysis; position-consistent pairwise results or TIE; per-criterion scores, uncertainty and limitations; judge version/drift and review plan

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Select deterministic checks when they establish the property. For remaining judgments, choose direct scoring against objective reference criteria or pairwise comparison for preferences; isolate one measurable property per criterion and anchor every scale point before scoring.

Require cited observable evidence before each score, with structured criterion-level rationale. Separate factual correctness, style and safety; confidence, authority, verbosity or length cannot substitute for evidence.

Use independently labeled held-out calibration examples, at least two reviewers where available, and analyze disagreement by criterion and slice. Human labels can be wrong; reconcile evidence rather than call disagreement proof of evaluator failure. Report unavailable calibration as a blocker to trust, not a passed judge.

For pairwise evaluation run both A/B and B/A orders, map display positions back to stable candidate IDs, and count a consistent winner only after that remapping. Disagreement becomes TIE/escalation with reduced confidence, not a forced majority from two votes.

Control position, length, verbosity, self-preference and authority biases; calibrate confidence against evidence, human agreement and observed consistency. A different judge family is a mitigation, not independence proof. Sensitive grading inputs remain restricted; model calls require current authorization and budget.

Analyze per-criterion agreement and ranking robustness. Use order-independent fixed-batch ranking when appropriate, sequential ranking only for its intended setting, and inspect intransitive cycles; do not treat rankings or confidence values as calibrated probabilities without evidence.

Version judge prompts, anchors and calibration sets. Recheck stability on prompt/model/tool or domain changes, route unresolved/safety-sensitive judgments to authorized review, and report measured quality with observed cost/latency; do not certify an agent from a judge design document.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
